Based on ELK 0.9.1

## elkjs changes
* update to mocha 10.3.0 by @Eddykasp in https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/pull/269
* #208 Add worker termination conditions and method by @skspade in https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/pull/274

## ELk Changes
These changes are not yet released in ELK, but are already included in this elkjs release.
* Consider node's size when computing available space in port placement by @Eddykasp https://github.com/eclipse/elk/pull/955

For all changes and fixed issues see the [ELK release notes](https://eclipse.dev/elk/downloads/releasenotes/release-0.9.1.html).
